title: One Family’s Fight Against the Dixie Fire

sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 Dealbook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 这是一档日常播客。

sentences.en: In a summer of weather extremes, the Dixie Fire in California has stood out for its enormous scale.
sentences.zh: 在一个极端天气的夏天，加利福尼亚州的迪克西大火以其庞大的规模脱颖而出。

sentences.en: And as it's burned its way across the state's forgotten rural towns, it has revealed just how far residents will
sentences.zh: 当它一路烧过该州被遗忘的乡村小镇时，它展现出了居民们为了

sentences.en: go to preserve their way of life, and just how divided they are about what has caused the fires that now endanger it.
sentences.zh: 保护他们的生活方式会付出多大的努力，以及对于是什么引发了这场危及其生存的大火，他们的分歧有多大。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Annie Coriall, on the experience of one California family, her own.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事安妮·科里尔将讲述一个加州家庭的经历，她自己的家庭。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 20 日星期一。

sentences.en: So my aunt and my uncle and my cousin and his wife, they live in Indian Valley.
sentences.zh: 我的姑妈、叔叔、表哥和他的妻子住在印第安谷。

sentences.en: Indian Valley is this beautiful high mountain valley in the northern
sentences.zh: 印第安谷是北部塞拉尼斯山脉中一个美丽的高山

sentences.en: Sierras.
sentences.zh: 山谷。

sentences.en: It's surrounded by thick green forest and the valley is covered in green pasture land where the cows graze.
sentences.zh: 它被茂密的绿色森林环绕，山谷里长满了牛群吃草的绿色牧场。

sentences.en: I've heard it referred to as the Switzerland of the Sierras.
sentences.zh: 我听人把它称为塞拉尼斯山脉的瑞士。

sentences.en: When my family came in the 1950s, this was still a really thriving area for mining and for logging.
sentences.zh: 当我的家人在 20 世纪 50 年代来到这里时，这里依然是一个非常繁荣的采矿和伐木区。

sentences.en: But those industries went into decline and a lot of people have left.
sentences.zh: 但这些行业走向了衰落，许多人已经离开。

sentences.en: So at this point, the towns have really been winnowed down to a very small population of people getting by as they can.
sentences.zh: 因此，目前这里的城镇确实已经萎缩，只剩下极少数勉强维生的人口。

sentences.en: And one of the few stable ways that people have to survive is cattle ranching.
sentences.zh: 人们赖以生存的少数稳定方式之一就是养牛。

sentences.en: And that's what my family does now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我家人现在所做的事。

sentences.en: Like many rural towns in America that have seen their fortunes changed, this place is isolated.
sentences.zh: 就像美国许多命运发生巨变的乡村城镇一样，这个地方是孤立的。

sentences.en: And they're a mix of people.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们背景各异。

sentences.en: But a lot of those who are left have become more conservative, particularly in recent years.
sentences.zh: 但留下来的人中有很多变得更加保守，尤其是在近年来。

sentences.en: And are generally distrustful of the government and the media.
sentences.zh: 并且普遍对政府和媒体不信任。

sentences.en: The raging Dixie fire continues to destroy everything in its path, including the gold rush era town of Greenville,
sentences.zh: 汹涌的迪克西大火继续摧毁着它路径上的一切，包括加利福尼亚州淘金热时期的城镇

sentences.en: California.
sentences.zh: 格林维尔。

sentences.en: And then the Dixie fire actually arrived in Indian Valley.
sentences.zh: 随后，迪克西大火真的蔓延到了印第安谷。

sentences.en: California's largest wildfire exploded in size overnight, forcing thousands more to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 加州最大的野火一夜之间规模爆增，迫使数千人进一步撤离。

sentences.en: And instead of leaving, my family decided to stay.
sentences.zh: 但我的家人决定留下来，而不是离开。

sentences.en: We simply cannot stress it enough.
sentences.zh: 我们怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: Firefighters are pleading with you to please evacuate when orders are given.
sentences.zh: 消防员恳请大家在接到指令时务必撤离。

sentences.en: And a part of me wanted to know why.
sentences.zh: 我内心的某个部分想知道为什么。

sentences.en: Why would they stay and fight these monster fires?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么还要留下来与这些怪物般的野火搏斗？

sentences.en: How did they think they could beat the Dixie fire?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么会觉得自己能战胜迪克西大火？

sentences.en: So I decided to go visit them and find out.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定去拜访他们并一探究竟。

sentences.en: Around mid-August, I hopped on a plane and I flew to Reno, Nevada.
sentences.zh: 大约在 8 月中旬，我登上一架飞机，飞往内华达州里诺市。

sentences.en: The skies were incredibly hazy.
sentences.zh: 天空异常朦胧。

sentences.en: It was very, very bad air.
sentences.zh: 空气质量非常非常差。

sentences.en: I picked up some supplies.
sentences.zh: 我采购了一些物资。

sentences.en: You ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: I am.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: How are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 你今天过得怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm doing great.
sentences.zh: 我过得很好。

sentences.en: I work indoors.
sentences.zh: 我在室内工作。

sentences.en: That's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 那是件好事。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A respirator, masks,
sentences.zh: 防毒面具、口罩、

sentences.en: goggles.
sentences.zh: 护目镜。

sentences.en: I may not need one of these.
sentences.zh: 我可能用不上这个。

sentences.en: I'll return it without opening it if that's all right.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我会在不拆封的情况下退掉它。

sentences.en: It's under your receipt.
sentences.zh: 它在你的收据下面。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: And I drove the two hours or so to my family's home.
sentences.zh: 我开车大约两个小时来到了我家人的住所。

sentences.en: And as I got closer to Indian Valley, there was what's known as a plume, the giant sort of puffy clouds that are created at the head of the fire.
sentences.zh: 当我离印第安谷越来越近时，出现了所谓的烟羽，即在火源头形成的巨大蓬松云团。

sentences.en: And you can't help but think of like a mushroom cloud when you see that image on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 当你看到地平线上的那个景象时，你禁不住会想起蘑菇云。

sentences.en: I started seeing forests that had been scorched.
sentences.zh: 我开始看到被烧焦的森林。

sentences.en: You know, all that remained were the blackened tree trunks and the ground was covered in ash.
sentences.zh: 你知道，剩下的只有熏黑的树干，地面上覆盖着灰烬。

sentences.en: And as I'm getting closer to my family's ranch, I come across a checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 当我越来越接近我家人的牧场时，我遇到了一个检查站。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Where someone from the National Guard waves me down.
sentences.zh: 国民警卫队的人把我拦了下来。

sentences.en: It's an evacuated area.
sentences.zh: 这是一个疏散区。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They're guarding the evacuation zone and they're not allowing people to go in.
sentences.zh: 他们在守卫疏散区，不允许人们进入。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But they let me pass because I'm a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 但他们让我通过了，因为我是记者。

sentences.en: And so I drive up to meet my family.
sentences.zh: 于是我开车去见我的家人。

sentences.en: Is it good?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: If it isn't my family.
sentences.zh: 这不是我的家人吗。

sentences.en: Hi, you guys.
sentences.zh: 嗨，你们好。

sentences.en: Well, I had to come and record on this myself.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不得不亲自来这里记录这一切。

sentences.en: Oh, Jesus.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I see my aunt, my uncle.
sentences.zh: 我看到了我的姑妈、叔叔。

sentences.en: Hi, Uncle Brian.
sentences.zh: 嗨，布赖恩叔叔。

sentences.en: I have to wear masks here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里必须戴口罩。

sentences.en: How are ya?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: But one person that I really want to talk to is my cousin's wife.
sentences.zh: 但我真正想交谈的人是我表哥的妻子。

sentences.en: Hi, Vanessa.
sentences.zh: 嗨，凡妮莎。

sentences.en: Vanessa Kingdon.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎·金登。

sentences.en: Oh my goodness, I only ever see her, hear from you.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，我只能见到你、听到你的声音。

sentences.en: And eventually we end up sitting down inside her house.
sentences.zh: 最终我们在她家里坐了下来。

sentences.en: And you didn't grow up here, Vanessa.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎，你不是在这里长大的。

sentences.en: You married.
sentences.zh: 你嫁过来了。

sentences.en: No one from the Central Valley where there aren't fires or mountains or anything.
sentences.zh: 没有来自中央山谷的人，那里没有火灾、山脉或其他任何东西。

sentences.en: Vanessa's not from the area.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎不是本地人。

sentences.en: She met my cousin Travis six years ago.
sentences.zh: 她六年前遇到了我的表哥特拉维斯。

sentences.en: And since then, she's been a part of their cattle ranching operation.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，她就加入了他们的养牛业务。

sentences.en: Before that, though, she was a model.
sentences.zh: 不过在那之前，她是一名模特。

sentences.en: She worked at auctions and big conventions.
sentences.zh: 她曾在拍卖会和大型会议上工作。

sentences.en: And she would model outdoor gear and hunting supplies.
sentences.zh: 她会为户外装备和狩猎用品担任模特。

sentences.en: I never felt like I should go home to my parents' house or evacuate, seek refuge somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有觉得我应该回我父母的家或撤离，去某个地方避难。

sentences.en: This is the first forest fire she's had to prepare to fight.
sentences.zh: 这是她第一次不得不准备应对森林大火。

sentences.en: And I ask her how she's planning to do that.
sentences.zh: 我问她打算怎么做。

sentences.en: And she tells me for the last few weeks that she and my cousin and my uncle and aunt have been trying to create what she called defensible space around their ranches.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，在过去的几周里，她、我的表哥、叔叔和姑妈一直在努力在他们的牧场周围建立她所谓的防御空间。

sentences.en: Which basically means they've been clearing brush and cutting down trees so that there's less that can catch on fire.
sentences.zh: 这基本上意味着他们一直在清理灌木丛和砍伐树木，这样可以燃烧的东西就变少了。

sentences.en: They've also been setting up fire hoses and pumps to draw water from the ponds so they can actually fight the fire if it comes to that.
sentences.zh: 他们还一直在安装消防水带和水泵从池塘抽水，以便在火灾真的来临时他们能够实际灭火。

sentences.en: You'll stay here and put out spot fires until it gets to the point where it feels like there's going to be a column collapse and everything's going to go up.
sentences.zh: 你们会留在这里扑灭零星火情，直到火势发展到感觉将要发生火羽坍塌、一切都将烧毁的地步。

sentences.en: Yeah, you'd feel pretty silly if you abandoned your house and then there was a little spot fire that you could have prevented or put out.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果你抛弃了房子，然后发生了一场你本可以预防或扑灭的小火，你会觉得自己很傻。

sentences.en: A lot of the destruction to homes and properties is caused by flying embers that fly out ahead of the fire and cause spot fires.
sentences.zh: 房屋和财产的大部分损毁是由飞向火灾前方并引起零星火灾的飞溅火星造成的。

sentences.en: And so by staying, they believed that they could shoot down embers so that they wouldn't cause fires and bring down their homes and barns.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过留下来，他们相信他们可以击落火星，这样它们就不会引发火灾并烧毁他们的房屋和谷仓。

sentences.en: And they're not enough firemen to be putting out those little fires at every home because it's coming on so many fronts.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的消防员去扑灭每个家庭的那些小火，因为火势从太多正面涌来。

sentences.en: Like today, I actually haven't seen any fire engines all day.
sentences.zh: 就像今天，我整天实际上都没有看到任何消防车。

sentences.en: And that has that...
sentences.zh: 情况一直……

sentences.en: That's been the case.
sentences.zh: 一直都是这样。

sentences.en: That's why we stay because we don't see the resources aren't here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们留下的原因，因为我们看不到资源在这里。

sentences.en: And so, and sometimes they show up an hour too late.
sentences.zh: 而且，有时他们出现时已经晚了一个小时。

sentences.en: What they told me was that their best shot they had at saving those ranches was sticking around and defending them themselves because they felt strongly that if they didn't defend them,
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我的意思是，他们拯救这些牧场的最好机会就是留下来自己防守，因为他们坚信如果他们不防守，

sentences.en: nobody else would.
sentences.zh: 别人也不会。

sentences.en: And there's too many people that have already lost homes that could have been prevented.
sentences.zh: 有太多人已经失去了本可以避免被毁的家园。

sentences.en: So that's why we're here.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们在这里的原因。

sentences.en: And not to be a liability or in anybody's way, you know, we're just trying to do our best and protect our home, our community and our livelihood.
sentences.zh: 为了不成为累赘或妨碍任何人，你知道，我们只是在尽最大努力保护我们的家园、社区和生计。

sentences.en: And as a last resort, you have the field down here to evacuate and you have a fifth wheel trailer there.
sentences.zh: 作为最后的手段，你这里有可以撤离的田野，那里有一辆第五轮拖车。

sentences.en: It's in the center of the valley and it's all irrigated pasture around.
sentences.zh: 它位于山谷中心，周围都是灌溉牧场。

sentences.en: And that's full of like...
sentences.zh: 里面装满了……

sentences.en: And my other car.
sentences.zh: 还有我的另一辆车。

sentences.en: That's equipment and personal iteMs.
sentences.zh: 那是设备和个人物品。

sentences.en: So you've packed up.
sentences.zh: 所以你们已经收拾好行李了。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: They do have a plan to sort of head for the irrigated fields, which are considered fire safe or fire safer, or even to take refuge in the ponds themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们确实有一个计划，就是前往被认为防火或更安全的灌溉田，甚至到池塘本身去避难。

sentences.en: Yeah, I need to like get some clothes and things like that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我需要拿一些衣服之类东西。

sentences.en: Do you want me to get your toothbrush and your stuff from the bathroom?
sentences.zh: 你想让我去浴室拿你的牙刷和你的东西吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, let me get a stuff.
sentences.zh: 好的，我去拿些东西。

sentences.en: Although I have, my phone is charged, but I'll take it.
sentences.zh: 虽然我的手机有电，但我会带着它。

sentences.en: I just need to get a bath.
sentences.zh: 我只需要洗个澡。

sentences.en: So as my family, Travis and Vanessa, are frantically preparing to fend off the fire, I get in touch with my editors and they say, You know what, this isn't safe.
sentences.zh: 正当我的家人特拉维斯和凡妮莎拼命准备抵御火灾时，我联系了我的编辑，他们说，你知道吗，这不安全。

sentences.en: You need to leave.
sentences.zh: 你需要离开。

sentences.en: You need to get out of the evacuated zone and find a safer location.
sentences.zh: 你需要离开疏散区，找一个更安全的地方。

sentences.en: So I have to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须走了。

sentences.en: It was really hard to say goodbye in these circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下告别真的很难。

sentences.en: My first concern was whether they would be okay.
sentences.zh: 我首先关心的是他们是否会平安无事。

sentences.en: I just worried that they might be outmatched by the Dixie fire.
sentences.zh: 我只是担心他们可能敌不过迪克西大火。

sentences.en: Okay, Auntie, thank you for giving us time.
sentences.zh: 好的，姑妈，谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: You're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用谢。

sentences.en: It's like, what a bright spot on this fire.
sentences.zh: 这就像是这场大火中多么闪亮的亮点。

sentences.en: To see each other.
sentences.zh: 能够见到彼此。

sentences.en: So after I left, there was no way for me to easily be in touch with my family.
sentences.zh: 在我离开后，我无法轻易与我的家人取得联系。

sentences.en: They have no landlines where they are, no Wi-Fi at that point, and very limited cell signal.
sentences.zh: 他们所在的地方没有座机，当时也没有无线网络，手机信号非常有限。

sentences.en: Finally, on the night of Friday, August 20th, we get a message from Vanessa, who's gone out to where she can get a cell signal, and sent us an update.
sentences.zh: 最终，在 8 月 20 日星期五的晚上，我们收到了凡妮莎的消息，她去了一个有手机信号的地方，并给我们发来了最新情况。

sentences.en: And it said, well, family, today was the day.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，好吧，家人们，今天就是日子了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费体验《纽约时报》一个月，还不需要绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你的第一个月将免费使用。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间去突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能看到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报App，享受30天免费阅读。

sentences.en: So several days later, I drive my Jeep back to Indian Valley, and I meet Vanessa at her house.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我开着吉普车回到印第安瓦利，在凡妮莎家见到了她。

sentences.en: And over the next day or so, she tells me what happened.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的大约一天时间里，她向我讲述了发生的事情。

sentences.en: For August 19th, I have photos at like 7.30 at night of us just kind of standing around and watching the fire.
sentences.zh: 在8月19日，我拍到了大约晚上7点半的照片，当时我们只是站在那里看着火势。

sentences.en: It was on August 19th that they first caught sight of the fire, which by then was coming over the nearest ridge, approaching the ranch.
sentences.zh: 正是在8月19日，他们第一次看到了大火，当时大火已经翻越了最近的山脊，正在逼近牧场。

sentences.en: There are fire crews there, hotshot crews.
sentences.zh: 那里有消防队员，还有精锐的突击消防队。

sentences.en: Crews had been preparing the area, digging trenches with bulldozers, hoping to hold back the fire.
sentences.zh: 消防队员一直在该地区进行准备，用推土机挖战壕，希望能阻挡火势。

sentences.en: But then it started to crown.
sentences.zh: 但随后火势开始向树冠蔓延。

sentences.en: But the next day, the fire jumped over those trenches.
sentences.zh: 但第二天，大火直接跳过了那些战壕。

sentences.en: At 103 is when it really started to look ominous.
sentences.zh: 1点03分的时候，情况看起来真的很不妙。

sentences.en: It was starting to get gray, and the sky was just covered in embers and a big plume.
sentences.zh: 天色开始变灰，空中到处都是飞溅的火星和滚滚浓烟。

sentences.en: And it was just getting closer and closer.
sentences.zh: 而且火势越来越近。

sentences.en: And you can hear the crowning.
sentences.zh: 你能听到树冠燃烧的声音。

sentences.en: And crowning is when the fire is at the tops of the trees instead of at the base or on the ground.
sentences.zh: 树冠燃烧是指大火在树顶燃烧，而不是在树根或地面上。

sentences.en: And once it's on the tops, it's really easy for it to spread from treetop to treetop and move very rapidly.
sentences.zh: 一旦火势到了树顶，就非常容易在树梢之间蔓延，并且移动得极快。

sentences.en: And it sounds like a jet.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像喷气式飞机一样。

sentences.en: You hear it coming down the hill.
sentences.zh: 你能听到它呼啸着冲下山坡。

sentences.en: And it seems like forever for it to get to you.
sentences.zh: 感觉它要冲到你这里花了极其漫长的时间。

sentences.en: But then when it does, it's like, oh my gosh, then you have to switch gears.
sentences.zh: 但当它真的到了的时候，天哪，你必须立刻切换状态。

sentences.en: And then you realize, okay, it's go time.
sentences.zh: 然后你意识到，好吧，决战时刻到了。

sentences.en: And at the point when the fire arrives, Vanessa is at the ranch alone with her 70-year-old mother-in-law, my Aunt Heather.
sentences.zh: 在大火抵达的那一刻，凡妮莎正和她70岁的婆婆——我的海瑟阿姨独自在牧场。

sentences.en: Their husbands, my Uncle Brian and my cousin Travis, had gone to check cows.
sentences.zh: 她们的丈夫，我的布莱恩叔叔和表弟特拉维斯，去查看牛群了。

sentences.en: And I remember having one moment of just like, where's Travis?
sentences.zh: 我记得当时闪过一个念头：特拉维斯在哪？

sentences.en: I swallowed, I took a deep breath, and I said, put your big girl panties on.
sentences.zh: 我咽了口唾沫，深吸了一口气，对自己说，拿出点大人的样来。

sentences.en: This is what's happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And so Vanessa and my Aunt Heather quickly kicked into high gear.
sentences.zh: 于是凡妮莎和海瑟阿姨迅速进入了高度戒备状态。

sentences.en: We ended up putting our jackets on, our respirators, our goggles.
sentences.zh: 我们最终穿上了外套、防毒面具和护目镜。

sentences.en: And they start rounding up the animals.
sentences.zh: 然后他们开始把动物赶拢。

sentences.en: You know, the horses were running around.
sentences.zh: 你知道，马匹四处奔跑。

sentences.en: They just knew something wasn't right.
sentences.zh: 它们只是本能地觉得有什么不对劲。

sentences.en: And we had to go ahead and catch them because we didn't want them to go through the fence or panic.
sentences.zh: 我们必须赶快抓住它们，因为我们不想让它们冲撞栅栏或惊慌失措。

sentences.en: So we ended up moving the horses in the barn.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最终把马匹转移到了马厩里。

sentences.en: And then that was just our main focus is to protect that structure.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们的主要任务就是保护那个建筑。

sentences.en: So they start spraying down the barns inside and out because it's obviously harder for an ember to catch fire on a wet structure.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始向马厩的内外喷水，因为湿润的建筑显然更不容易被火星点燃。

sentences.en: We were soaked and we couldn't see out of our goggles because of all the spray from the hoses.
sentences.zh: 我们浑身湿透，由于水管喷出的水雾，护目镜什么也看不清。

sentences.en: And all we did was just wet down everything, everything the hoses would reach.
sentences.zh: 我们所做的就是把一切都浇湿，只要水管能够到的地方都浇湿。

sentences.en: So these aren't your everyday garden hoses.
sentences.zh: 所以这些可不是你们日常用的花园水管。

sentences.en: These are heavy duty firefighting hoses that are hooked up to pumps that have drawn water from the ponds and they're pressurized.
sentences.zh: 这些是连接着水泵的重型消防水管，水是从池塘里抽出来的，带有压力。

sentences.en: They are spouting water at such a force that if you were to lose control of them, they could actually flip and knock out your teeth.
sentences.zh: 它们喷射出的水力极强，如果你不小心失控，它们甚至会反弹并打掉你的牙齿。

sentences.en: You can see the fire behind it.
sentences.zh: 你能看到火就在它后面。

sentences.en: It's orange and it's starting to swirl and has a mind of its own.
sentences.zh: 呈橙色，开始盘旋，仿佛有了自己的意识。

sentences.en: Could you feel heat?
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到热量吗？

sentences.en: Could you feel, was there ash in the air?
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到吗，空气中有灰烬吗？

sentences.en: Yes, the ash in the air.
sentences.zh: 是的，空气中有灰烬。

sentences.en: Definitely having the respirator on made all the difference.
sentences.zh: 戴着防毒面具绝对起到了关键作用。

sentences.en: Otherwise it would just burn when you were breathing it.
sentences.zh: 否则你呼吸时肺部就会有灼痛感。

sentences.en: In your eyes, the ash getting in your eyes, it's painful.
sentences.zh: 灰烬飞进眼睛里，非常痛苦。

sentences.en: So they switch from spraying down the structures to literally having to shoot down these embers as they fall from the sky.
sentences.zh: 所以他们从喷水保护建筑，变成了必须亲手去扑灭从天而降的火星。

sentences.en: These are burning twigs and branches and the fire itself.
sentences.zh: 这些都是燃烧的细枝、树枝以及火势本身。

sentences.en: And at this point, there are no fire engines around.
sentences.zh: 而在此时，周围没有任何消防车。

sentences.en: There weren't any people patrolling.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何人进行巡逻。

sentences.en: And after a while, their husbands arrive.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，他们的丈夫赶到了。

sentences.en: And at about the same time, several fire engines arrive and firefighters begin pouring out onto the road.
sentences.zh: 差不多在同一时间，几辆消防车抵达，消防队员开始涌上道路。

sentences.en: And what do they do?
sentences.zh: 他们做了什么？

sentences.en: What do the firefighters do when they appear?
sentences.zh: 消防队员出现时做了什么？

sentences.en: They all just stand around.
sentences.zh: 他们只是站在周围无所事事。

sentences.en: And they did put some hose layout, but they put it on top of the hoses we already had.
sentences.zh: 他们确实铺设了一些水管，但他们把水管压在我们已经铺好的水管上面。

sentences.en: And then they stand around because there were no structures on fire.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就站在那里闲逛，因为没有建筑着火。

sentences.en: And that's their sole purpose is to make sure that if there's a structure fire, they put it out.
sentences.zh: 而他们的唯一职责就是确保如果有建筑着火，他们就去扑灭。

sentences.en: So they weren't going to be helping us wet everything down.
sentences.zh: 所以他们才不会帮我们把所有东西都浇湿。

sentences.en: But I swear to you, if we were not out there soaking every square inch we could, there would have been a fire.
sentences.zh: 但我向你发誓，如果我们没有亲自去浸湿每一个平方英寸，这里早就着火了。

sentences.en: And it would have probably taken a barn or two or whatever.
sentences.zh: 而且可能会烧毁一两个马厩之类的东西。

sentences.en: And that's their policy is that unless there's a structure on fire.
sentences.zh: 他们的政策就是，除非有建筑正在起火。

sentences.en: Conserve your water.
sentences.zh: 节约用水。

sentences.en: Conserve the water.
sentences.zh: 节约用水。

sentences.en: There's like 500 gallons, give or take, in those fire engines.
sentences.zh: 那些消防车里大概只有500加仑左右的水。

sentences.en: So they look at it like, oh, we only want to use it if we absolutely have to.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的想法是，哦，我们只想在万不得已时才使用它。

sentences.en: And we're over here with huge ponds we're pumping out of.
sentences.zh: 而我们这边有巨大的池塘可以抽水。

sentences.en: And we don't need to conserve water.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不需要节约用水。

sentences.en: Now, I spoke to the fire authorities, and they actually said there's no policy about conserving water.
sentences.zh: 现在，我与消防部门进行了交谈，他们实际上表示并没有关于节约用水的政策。

sentences.en: The firefighters assigned to protect homes, they're supposed to do whatever they can to defend them.
sentences.zh: 被指派保护房屋的消防队员理应尽一切努力来捍卫这些房屋。

sentences.en: So if they didn't jump into action, as Vanessa claims they didn't, I was told it was because the firefighters didn't think it was necessary.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他们没有像凡妮莎所说的那样立即行动，我得到的解释是消防队员认为没有那个必要。

sentences.en: But she's also expressing a frustration that I heard from a lot of people here.
sentences.zh: 但她也表达了一种我在当地许多人身上听到的沮丧情绪。

sentences.en: And that's that the fire crews haven't always been there, even though the fire has been raging right there.
sentences.zh: 那就是消防队并不总是在场，尽管大火就在眼前肆虐。

sentences.en: What I've heard over and over again from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我从负责加州这一地区的消防权威机构美国林务局那里听到过无数次的是：

sentences.en: Forest Service, which is the fire authority in charge of this part of California, is that their priority is to save lives, then to save homes, then to save resources.
sentences.zh: 他们的首要任务是拯救生命，其次是拯救房屋，最后是拯救资源。

sentences.en: So lives are their number one priority.
sentences.zh: 因此，生命是他们的头等大事。

sentences.en: That means residents.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当地居民。

sentences.en: What that also means is that firefighting resources tend to get sent to more populated areas with more structures,
sentences.zh: 这也意味着消防资源往往会被派往人口更稠密、建筑更多的地方，

sentences.en: especially at a time when there's so many big fires and resources are spread so thin.
sentences.zh: 特别是在有如此多的大火、资源捉襟见肘的时候。

sentences.en: And that has left people in rural areas, like Vanessa, feeling like they're being left behind to fight the fire on their own.
sentences.zh: 这让像凡妮莎这样生活在农村地区的人们感到，他们被抛弃了，只能孤军奋战。

sentences.en: There was still fire above us, and now we had fire on the other side of the valley.
sentences.zh: 我们上方仍然有火，现在山谷的另一边也有了火。

sentences.en: So you're kind of getting surrounded, like it's almost like in a C shape that is curled around one side of the ranch, and now you're having it pretty much on three sides?
sentences.zh: 所以你有点被包围了，就像一个C字形包围着牧场的一侧，现在基本上三面受敌？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: At that point, the fire is sort of raging right around the perimeter of my family's ranch.
sentences.zh: 在那时，大火几乎在我家人牧场的边缘疯狂肆虐。

sentences.en: And it roars through the forest closest to them on one side, just all the way up to the tops of the trees.
sentences.zh: 它在一侧吞噬了离他们最近的森林，火势直窜树顶。

sentences.en: And the sky is black with smoke.
sentences.zh: 天空被浓烟熏得漆黑一片。

sentences.en: And it then jumps the road, and it gets into a stand of trees, goes up a hill,
sentences.zh: 然后它跳过了公路，冲进了一片树林，爬上一座小山，

sentences.en: jumps a river, and goes into a forest on the other side of the valley about half a mile away.
sentences.zh: 跨过一条河，冲进了大约半英里外山谷另一侧的森林。

sentences.en: And this all happens in about 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 这一切都在大约45分钟内发生。

sentences.en: So what I heard over and over again was that it's like 20 minutes of hell, and then it's just over.
sentences.zh: 所以我听到最多的是，这就好像经历了20分钟的地狱，然后就结束了。

sentences.en: But then a few days later, the fire comes back.
sentences.zh: 但几天后，大火卷土重来。

sentences.en: And Vanessa and my family have to fight it again and again, each time they successfully fight the fire off.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎和我的家人不得不一次又一次地与它战斗，每一次他们都成功击退了火魔。

sentences.en: We know, because we're living it, that it is constant.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，因为我们身处其中，这一切是持续不断的。

sentences.en: Like, no matter where you look, you see something on fire.
sentences.zh: 无论你往哪里看，都能看到着火的东西。

sentences.en: Some mountain is on fire.
sentences.zh: 某座山正在燃烧。

sentences.en: How, I mean, there's, you've described to me feeling physical symptoms of having lived through this for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你向我描述过，经历了这六周的生活后，你感到了身体上的不适。

sentences.en: What are some of those physical symptoms?
sentences.zh: 有哪些身体症状？

sentences.en: Oh, God, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，我不知道。

sentences.en: I can be really vain here and say that my skin has gone to hell, you know, all the ash in the air, my lungs, my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我可以自恋地说，我的皮肤变得一团糟，你知道的，空气里全是灰烬，还有我的肺和眼睛。

sentences.en: I wake up in the morning and my eyes feel like they have rocks in them or they're really dry.
sentences.zh: 我早上醒来，感觉眼睛里像进了沙子一样，或者干涩无比。

sentences.en: And what about the psychological toll?
sentences.zh: 那心理上的代价呢？

sentences.en: It's like running the longest marathon of your life and having to focus on getting through it.
sentences.zh: 这就像跑你人生中最长的一场马拉松，你必须全神贯注地坚持下去。

sentences.en: And, like, you can't let down.
sentences.zh: 而且，你不能松懈。

sentences.en: You can't let down yet.
sentences.zh: 你还不能松懈。

sentences.en: And yet, like, what are the rewards?
sentences.zh: 然而，有什么回报呢？

sentences.en: You get to come home to your house, walk in the door, and it's still a home.
sentences.zh: 你能回到自己的家，走进门，它依然是个家。

sentences.en: And it's standing.
sentences.zh: 它还完好地伫立着。

sentences.en: In talking to Vanessa, it was clear to me that she felt like her decision not to follow the evacuation orders had paid off.
sentences.zh: 在与凡妮莎交谈时，我很明显地感觉到，她觉得她拒绝服从疏散令的决定是值得的。

sentences.en: That it was what she and my cousin and my aunt and uncle did, not the firefighters, that saved the property.
sentences.zh: 是她、我的表弟、我的阿姨和叔叔所做的一切，而不是消防队员，拯救了这处房产。

sentences.en: And did it ever cross your minds to leave?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有哪怕一瞬间想过离开？

sentences.en: No, never.
sentences.zh: 没有，从来没有。

sentences.en: And, of course, I had family members urging me to leave.
sentences.zh: 当然，我有家人催促我离开。

sentences.en: And, no, there's no way we would leave our home, our animals, our responsibility.
sentences.zh: 但绝不，我们绝不可能离开我们的家、我们的动物和我们的责任。

sentences.en: So if you feel like if you hadn't stayed, you would have lost at least part of the ranch, you could have looked at it.
sentences.zh: 所以你觉得，如果你当时没有留下来，你至少会失去部分牧场，你可以这样看。

sentences.en: Because the fire truck showed up after it had already blazed through to them.
sentences.zh: 因为消防车是在火势已经席卷过去之后才出现的。

sentences.en: They're doing their job.
sentences.zh: 他们在尽职尽责。

sentences.en: And I'm not faulting them for that, but it is their job.
sentences.zh: 我并没有因此责怪他们，但这是他们的工作。

sentences.en: They are paid to do that.
sentences.zh: 他们拿了薪水来做这件事。

sentences.en: It is not where they sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 这里并不是他们夜宿的家。

sentences.en: And the people that lost their house and it's burnt to ashes, they're stuck in a fire camp.
sentences.zh: 而那些失去房屋、家园化为灰烬的人，他们被困在消防营地里。

sentences.en: They're stuck in an evacuation camp or in a friend or family's home.
sentences.zh: 他们被困在疏散营地里，或者寄宿在朋友和亲戚家中。

sentences.en: And their whole world and life has changed.
sentences.zh: 他们的整个世界和生活都改变了。

sentences.en: So, of course, you can't even compare because somebody doing their job, yeah, it sucks to lose a structure, but it doesn't change their world.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，这根本无法比较，因为对别人来说只是在工作，失去一座建筑虽然糟糕，但并不会改变他们的世界。

sentences.en: For the firefighters.
sentences.zh: 对于消防队员来说。

sentences.en: For the firefighter.
sentences.zh: 对于消防员而言。

sentences.en: But doesn't it make sense?
sentences.zh: 但这难道没有道理吗？

sentences.en: I mean, yes, it sounds incredibly frustrating for you guys.
sentences.zh: 我是说，是的，对你们来说这听起来令人无比沮丧。

sentences.en: But bigger picture, if you've only got so many resources to spread around,
sentences.zh: 但从宏观来看，如果你手里只有有限的资源可以分配，

sentences.en: doesn't it make sense for them to send the fire engines and the aircraft to places where there are more people, where there's a larger concentration of structures?
sentences.zh: 他们把消防车和飞机派往人口更多、建筑物更集中的地方，难道不是理所当然的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, if where they're pulling them from isn't still threatened, and we are still very much threatened.
sentences.zh: 是的，如果他们抽调资源的地方不再受到威胁的话，而我们这里依然面临着巨大的威胁。

sentences.en: We still have fires all over this valley.
sentences.zh: 我们这个山谷到处都还在着火。

sentences.en: And then the tax base, like, they don't make as much money on us as they are going to make around Tahoe area.
sentences.zh: 还有税基的问题，他们在我们身上赚不到像在太浩湖地区那样多的钱。

sentences.en: So what Vanessa's talking about here is that at this very moment, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以凡妮莎在这里谈到的是，就在此时此刻，美国林务局和消防部门开始不得不将资源、消防队伍和飞机，

sentences.en: Forest Service and the firefighting authorities are starting to have to pull resources, fire crews and aircraft,
sentences.zh: 从她的地区抽调走，去支援威胁着太浩湖周边地区的大型火线。

sentences.en: from her area to send them to the big fronts threatening the area around Lake Tahoe.
sentences.zh: 而凡妮莎说，太浩湖能得到资源是因为他们有更大的税基。

sentences.en: And what Vanessa says is that Tahoe is getting the resources because they have a bigger tax base.
sentences.zh: 他们比这些小型农村社区更富有。

sentences.en: They're richer than these small rural communities.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至提到了旅游业。

sentences.en: And they even mentioned, like, the tourism.
sentences.zh: 比如，现在正是旅游旺季。

sentences.en: Like, this is peak tourism season.
sentences.zh: 所以他们拼了命也要保住那里。

sentences.en: And so they're hell-bent on saving that.
sentences.zh: 农村社区很多时候都被遗忘了。

sentences.en: Rural communities are forgotten a lot of times.
sentences.zh: 农村社区很多时候都被遗忘了。

sentences.en: Or they're not top priority.
sentences.zh: 或者它们并非首要任务。

sentences.en: The evacuation orders for their community came down right on the heels of the destruction of a town called Greenville.
sentences.zh: 他们社区的疏散令是在格林ville镇被毁后不久下达的。

sentences.en: And it was pretty much burned to the ground.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎被完全烧成了平地。

sentences.en: I just saw Greenville for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚第一次见到格林ville。

sentences.en: Greenville, which burned down on August 4th.
sentences.zh: 格林ville在8月4日被大火烧毁。

sentences.en: And I was a little choked up, thinking, like, oh, my gosh, it is so bad.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点哽咽，心想，天哪，情况太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And those poor people.
sentences.zh: 还有那些可怜的人们。

sentences.en: And it looks like a third-world country that's been bombed.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像是一个遭到轰炸的发展中国家。

sentences.en: Now, it can be hard to argue with the fact that Greenville, which is this little rural town, burned down.
sentences.zh: 现在，格林ville这个偏远小镇被烧毁的事实很难反驳。

sentences.en: While South Lake Tahoe, which is more populated and where there's a lot more money, was ultimately saved.
sentences.zh: 而南太浩湖人口更多、资金更充足，最终却得到了拯救。

sentences.en: And you could see why that might seem to support Vanessa's theory that the fire authorities aren't doing enough to save rural communities like hers.
sentences.zh: 你可以理解为什么这似乎支持了瓦妮莎的理论，即消防当局在拯救像她这样的偏远社区时做得不够。

sentences.en: But when I talked to people who have been studying the behavior of the Dixie Fire, what they told me was that it may come down to the extreme behavior of this fire.
sentences.zh: 但当我与那些研究迪克西大火行为的人交谈时，他们告诉我，这可能归咎于这场大火极端的火势行为。

sentences.en: And the fact that no matter how many resources you throw at it, sometimes you just can't fight it.
sentences.zh: 事实是，无论你投入多少救援力量，有时你就是无法与之对抗。

sentences.en: It is creating high winds that are throwing embers out a mile or more in front of the fire.
sentences.zh: 它产生的强风将火星吹到一英里甚至更远的前方。

sentences.en: It's jumping dozer lines.
sentences.zh: 它正在跨越推土机开出的防火隔离带。

sentences.en: It's really defying everything that fire authorities know about fire and defeating every tool that they have to fight it back.
sentences.zh: 它真的打破了消防部门对火灾的认知，击败了他们反击的所有工具。

sentences.en: So firefighters are working really hard everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以消防员们在各地都极其努力地工作。

sentences.en: And sometimes what they do works, and sometimes it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 有时他们的做法管用，有时则不然。

sentences.en: And I think it's undeniable that our changing climate has made this a very urgent issue.
sentences.zh: 我认为不可否认的是，我们不断变化的气候使这成为一个非常紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: But as I talked with Vanessa, it was clear to me she thinks this goes beyond climate change.
sentences.zh: 但正如我和瓦妮莎交谈时所感受到的，很明显她认为这已经超出了气候变化的范畴。

sentences.en: What's the alternative?
sentences.zh: 那还有什么选择？

sentences.en: What can people do in the battle between man and nature when it comes to climate change and extreme weather?
sentences.zh: 在面对气候变化和极端天气时，人类与自然的较量中，人们还能做什么？

sentences.en: There's nothing that can be done.
sentences.zh: 无可奈何。

sentences.en: What is the alternative?
sentences.zh: 还有别的选择吗？

sentences.en: Don't be naive.
sentences.zh: 别天真了。

sentences.en: Don't believe that it's climate change alone.
sentences.zh: 不要相信这仅仅是气候变化造成的。

sentences.en: Don't think that, yeah, you can't throwing your hands up and saying it's climate change and there's nothing we can do.
sentences.zh: 不要认为，是的，你不能一摊手就说是气候变化，然后我们就无能为力了。

sentences.en: And it's, that's that.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: That's the easy way out.
sentences.zh: 那是逃避现实的简单做法。

sentences.en: That's like, it's being, that's just putting your head in the sand.
sentences.zh: 这就好比是，那就是自欺欺人。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: More than climate change, Vanessa thinks it's actually decisions by the government that are contributing to these massive fires.
sentences.zh: 瓦妮莎认为，除了气候变化，实际上是政府的决策导致了这些大范围的火灾。

sentences.en: For example, throughout the last century, authorities put out all fires, which would naturally have cleared out the forest floors.
sentences.zh: 例如，在上个世纪，当局扑灭了所有本可以自然清理林地地表腐殖质的火灾。

sentences.en: Letting them grow into these thick, untouched forests that can become like tinderboxes.
sentences.zh: 任由它们长成厚厚且未受干扰的森林，变得像火药桶一样。

sentences.en: And my cousin Travis points to what he thinks is another problem with how forests have been managed.
sentences.zh: 我的表弟特拉维斯指出了他认为森林管理存在的另一个问题。

sentences.en: The government hasn't been cutting down trees.
sentences.zh: 政府一直没有砍伐树木。

sentences.en: It is dry here.
sentences.zh: 这里很干燥。

sentences.en: This is not the rainforeSt.
sentences.zh: 这里不是雨林。

sentences.en: This is not the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 这里不是海岸。

sentences.en: It's no place for densely forested mountains.
sentences.zh: 这里根本不适合茂密的森林山脉。

sentences.en: It needs to be thin.
sentences.zh: 它需要被间伐。

sentences.en: And they went through a stage to where there was, from the 80s on, they just stopped all management.
sentences.zh: 他们经历了一个阶段，从80年代开始，他们干脆停止了所有管理。

sentences.en: So they stopped all management and that's created the conditions for this to get.
sentences.zh: 所以他们停止了所有的管理，这就为这一切创造了条件。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a domino effect.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个多米诺骨牌效应。

sentences.en: Like I said, it all could have been prevented.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这一切本可以避免。

sentences.en: There's no reason that it should have burned the entire Indian Valley.
sentences.zh: 根本没有理由把整个印第安山谷都烧掉。

sentences.en: People like Travis and Vanessa,
sentences.zh: 像特拉维斯和瓦妮莎这样的人，

sentences.en: they expressed to me that they had kind of a bone to pick with these environmental groups who had fought so hard to keep loggers off the land and to stop thinning projects,
sentences.zh: 他们向我表达了他们对这些环保组织的不满，这些组织曾极力反对伐木工人进入林区并阻止间伐项目，

sentences.en: only to have these forests erupt in flames and be all but destroyed.
sentences.zh: 结果这些森林最终爆发出冲天大火，几乎毁于一旦。

sentences.en: I mean, we shouldn't be allowing environmental groups to halt logging or thinning projects because of, say, the spotted owl, which is...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们不应该因为斑点林鸮等原因而允许环保组织叫停伐木或间伐项目，斑点林鸮是...

sentences.en: So spotted owl, timber wolves, there have been all these environmental groups that have been a huge force.
sentences.zh: 所以斑点林鸮、森林狼，所有这些环保组织曾是一股巨大的力量。

sentences.en: A lot of this forest land has remained largely untouched.
sentences.zh: 许多这样的林地在很大程度上一直未被触及。

sentences.en: It hasn't been thinned.
sentences.zh: 没有进行间伐。

sentences.en: There's been a strong push not to go in and clear the land.
sentences.zh: 一直有强烈的呼声反对进入林地进行清理。

sentences.en: There's so many benefits to managing the forest, whether...
sentences.zh: 管理森林有如此多的好处，无论...

sentences.en: And, like, if you want to get into the carbon issue, when all these resources burn, it's immediately released.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你想谈论碳排放问题，当所有这些资源燃烧时，碳会立即被释放出来。

sentences.en: Tons of carbon.
sentences.zh: 数以吨计的碳。

sentences.en: And in a horrible way.
sentences.zh: 而且是以一种可怕的方式。

sentences.en: You know, it's not natural decomposition or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这不是自然的分解过程之类的。

sentences.en: It's...
sentences.zh: 它是...

sentences.en: They're burnt.
sentences.zh: 它们被烧毁了。

sentences.en: It's instant.
sentences.zh: 这是瞬间发生的。

sentences.en: So there's a sustainable way...
sentences.zh: 所以有一种可持续的方式……

sentences.en: That can store that carbon for hundreds of years.
sentences.zh: 可以将这些碳储存数百年。

sentences.en: There's a sustainable way to manage the forests, in your opinion, so that they aren't left...
sentences.zh: 在你看来，有一种可持续的方式来管理森林，这样它们就不会留下来……

sentences.en: To burn.
sentences.zh: 任由烧毁。

sentences.en: To burn.
sentences.zh: 任由烧毁。

sentences.en: And then, I mean, what about the...
sentences.zh: 然后，我的意思是，那关于……

sentences.en: And Travis and Vanessa's point of view is one that many people in the area hold.
sentences.zh: 特拉维斯和瓦妮莎的观点也是该地区许多人的看法。

sentences.en: It's really been a bit of a divide.
sentences.zh: 这确实造成了一定程度的分歧。

sentences.en: They blame poor forest management for these massive fires, while environmentalists and California's elected officials blame climate change.
sentences.zh: 他们将这些特大火灾归咎于糟糕的森林管理，而环保主义者和加州的民选官员则将其归咎于气候变化。

sentences.en: But I think what the Dixie Fire has really shown us is that it's actually both.
sentences.zh: 但我认为迪克西大火真正向我们表明的是，这实际上是两者的结合。

sentences.en: That it's not an either-or.
sentences.zh: 这不是非此即彼的关系。

sentences.en: There's growing consensus from both sides of the debate that it's rising temperature and drought and high winds combined with thick forests that have created the current dangerous situation.
sentences.zh: 辩论双方的共识日益增加：气温上升、干旱、强风加上茂密的森林，共同造成了当前危险的局势。

sentences.en: I had put out in January a proposal for the legislature to invest a record amount in our home hardening, our forest health, as well as fuel break and vegetation management efforts.
sentences.zh: 我在一月份向立法机关提出了一项提案，要求创纪录地投资于我们的房屋抗灾加固、森林健康以及防火隔离带和植被管理工作。

sentences.en: A billion dollars.
sentences.zh: 十亿美元。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, the Dixie Fire kind of vindicated people like Travis and Vanessa, because forest management has become so much more a part of the mainstream conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，迪克西大火在某种程度上证明了特拉维斯和瓦妮莎等人的看法是正确的，因为森林管理已经更多地成为主流对话的一部分。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, what they went through, what they lived as they fought the fire, really ended up confirming what they already believed.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他们所经历的、他们在与火灾抗争时的亲身生活，最终证实了他们原有的信念。

sentences.en: Which is that they were ultimately an afterthought for the government.
sentences.zh: 那就是政府最终把他们当成了事后才想到的配角。

sentences.en: That they were forgotten and that they would be on their own.
sentences.zh: 他们被遗忘了，只能自生自灭。

sentences.en: What do you think is going to be like the legacy of people here, how they feel about the authorities?
sentences.zh: 你认为这里的人们会留下怎样的历史影响，他们对当局会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: It's going to breed a whole new generation of like the prepper type mentality, I have a feeling.
sentences.zh: 我感觉这会滋生出全新一代的末日求生型心态。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think people will start looking at it and going, oh,
sentences.zh: 是的，我想人们会开始关注并心想，哦，

sentences.en: maybe we should be a little more prepared or maybe like you don't evacuate or somebody sticks around to make sure there's not a spot fire that burns the house down that could have been squashed with your garden hose,
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该做更多准备，或者也许你不该撤离，或者留下来一个人，确保没有那种可以用花园水管扑灭的飞火把房子烧毁，

sentences.en: you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm sure people will rethink that, but I mean, for us, this just means we will be more prepared for next fire season.
sentences.zh: 我相信人们会重新考虑这一点，但对我们来说，这意味着我们将为下一个火灾季节做更充分的准备。

sentences.en: Because it's clear to us now, you cannot count on anybody to save yourself.
sentences.zh: 因为我们现在很清楚，你不能指望任何人来拯救你。

sentences.en: What would it take for you guys to say, I'm going to move to somewhere else and start our business over again?
sentences.zh: 要发生什么，才会让你们说出“我要搬到别的地方去，重新开始我们的生意”这样的话？

sentences.en: You never could.
sentences.zh: 你永远不可能。

sentences.en: It's physically impossible to be able to get this much ground.
sentences.zh: 管理这么大片土地在物理上是不可能的。

sentences.en: You can't move these cows to the other side of, you know, the country.
sentences.zh: 你不可能把这些牛赶到你知道的国家的另一边去。

sentences.en: They're not acclimated to that area and we would never be able to still be ranchers if we got up and moved.
sentences.zh: 它们不适应那个地区的习惯，如果我们背井离乡，就再也无法以放牧为生了。

sentences.en: Travis would have to go back to contracting and I would go get a job if need be.
sentences.zh: 如果有必要，特拉维斯将不得不回去承揽建筑承包工作，而我也去找一份工作。

sentences.en: This, I don't ever see us leaving.
sentences.zh: 我看不出我们有离开这里的可能。

sentences.en: I mean, I really don't.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的看不出。

sentences.en: This is our home and this is where I want to live the rest of my life.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的家，也是我想度过余生的发方。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.zh: 我将大声朗读这些书。

sentences.zh: 科恩医生投了反对票。

sentences.en: Dr. Portnoy voted yes.
sentences.zh: 波特诺伊医生投了赞成票。

sentences.en: Dr. Lee voted no.
sentences.zh: 李医生投了反对票。

sentences.en: A panel of medical experts has issued a highly anticipated recommendation on booster shots of Pfizer's COVID-19 vaccine to the FDA,
sentences.zh: 一个医学专家小组向美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）发布了一项备受期待的关于辉瑞新冠疫苗加强针的建议，

sentences.en: saying they should not be given to most Americans.
sentences.zh: 称绝大多数美国人不应该注射加强针。

sentences.en: This vote did not pass since the majority voted no.
sentences.zh: 由于多数人投了反对票，该投票未获通过。

sentences.en: The panel's recommendation undermines a plan from the Biden administration to give booster shots to anyone over 16, eight months after their second shot.
sentences.zh: 专家组的建议削弱了拜登政府的计划，即在接种第二剂疫苗八个月后，向所有16岁以上的人提供加强针。

sentences.en: Instead, the panel recommended booster shots only for those who are 65 or older or are at a high risk of severe infection.
sentences.zh: 相反，专家组建议仅为65岁及以上或面临严重感染高风险的人群接种加强针。

sentences.en: While the FDA is not bound by the recommendations of advisory panels, it tends to follow them.
sentences.zh: 虽然FDA不受顾问小组建议的约束，但它通常会遵循这些建议。
